name: Kyle Jarzmik
tagline: Top rated Criminal Defense attorney in Atlanta, Georgia
education: Georgia State University College of Law
about: Kyle Jarzmik is a criminal defense attorney in Atlanta, Georgia. He owns the law firm Kyle H. Jarzmik Law and has more than a decade of experience. Mr. Jarzmik has great insight into the criminal justice system and has defended clients in hundreds of cases. His experience extends to sex crimes, theft crimes, drug violations, DUI charges, traffic offenses, assault, battery and more.

Apart from criminal defense, Mr. Jarzmik also possesses experience representing personal injury clients in cases involving premises liability, motor vehicle accidents, catastrophic injuries and wrongful death. He understands that a criminal accusation or bodily injury can cause significant stress and loss of freedom and does everything in his power to make his clients’ lives better.

In 2004, Mr. Jarzmik graduated magna cum laude with a Bachelor of Arts in economics from Wake Forest University. He later pursued his legal education and obtained his Juris Doctor from Georgia State University College of Law in 2008.

A former Fulton County Assistant Solicitor General, Mr. Jarzmik has prosecuted myriad cases to verdict. During that time, he gained experience in everything from hit-and-run to second-degree vehicular homicide. At the beginning of his legal career, he interned at the U.S. Attorney’s Office for the Northern District of Georgia.

Qualified to practice in all the state courts of Georgia since 2008, Mr. Jarzmik is also admitted to practice before the Court of Appeals of Georgia, the Supreme Court of Georgia and the U.S. District Court for the Northern District of Georgia.

A valued member of his legal community, Mr. Jarzmik holds memberships in the criminal law sections of the Cobb County Bar Association and the Atlanta Bar Association. He is also a member of the Georgia Association of Criminal Defense Lawyers, the National College for DUI Defense and the State Bar of Georgia’s Young Lawyers Division.
